CODE   
Art. 2.3.74. 
Duty to provide information 
After dissolution of the matrimonial property regime, each spouse is obliged to provide the other spouse with all information on the composition of his or her original and final assets. On request, he or she must provide supporting documents. Either spouse may demand the presentation of a true and sincere inventory. At his request, he must be called to this inventory. They may also require the inventory to be drawn up by a notary at their own expense.
Paragraph 1 also applies where one of the spouses has requested the dissolution of the marriage or the early liquidation of the participation claim.
